title: Bot Browser renamed to Card Browser
reality: v2.3.0 renamed Bot Browser to Card Browser throughout the interface, docs, onboarding, and Professor Mari guidance, and renamed 'Browse Online' to 'Download Cards'; the online browser now opens inside the unified library shell as 'Cards Library' with a 'Browse character cards online' intro (2.3.0 Changed + Fixed; 2.3.1 also fixed Card Browser requests behind proxies). Provider fetches (Chub, CharacterTavern, Wyvern) were consolidated behind a safeFetch boundary (#3617).
fix: In the Import/Export section (line 182 of references/character-cards.md), replace 'all searchable from the in-app Bot Browser' with 'all searchable from the in-app Card Browser (renamed from Bot Browser in v2.3.0; opens as the Cards Library shell, with the Browse Online action renamed to Download Cards)'.

title: About Me AI drafting moved to Professor Mari
reality: v2.3.2 moved Conversation About Me drafting from per-editor AI Write controls to Professor Mari: Character and Persona Convo editors no longer expose a separate model connection or source settings; Mari inspects a saved character/persona, writes the bio in their voice, and saves it directly to the real About Me field. (Earlier, v2.3.0 #3646 had fixed the old AI Write path sending literal {{user}} macros, but that path is now removed.)
fix: Rewrite the aboutMe bullet in the 'Conversation-mode Profile' section (line 103): drop the claim that a gear-icon source picker in the card editor drives an AI-write draft via aboutMeSources with a per-editor model connection; state that as of v2.3.2 About Me drafting is done by Professor Mari, who writes the bio in the character/persona's voice and saves it to the real aboutMe field. Also add About Me bio drafting to the 'What Mari can actually do' list in the Professor Mari section. Keep aboutMe itself and the per-chat about-me override (line 104), which are unchanged.

title: Mari/app-data updates preserve unrelated card fields
reality: v2.3.2 (#3708) fixed Professor Mari and other app-data callers wiping greetings, example dialogue, creator notes, system prompts, post-history instructions, character versions, and alternate greetings when updating an unrelated Character Card field; these are now preserved. v2.3.0 (#3674) also fixed Mari returning blank character generation turns and normalized common card field names.
fix: In the Professor Mari section (near the character.create/update capabilities, ~line 130), add a note: since v2.3.2 (#3708) Mari and other app-data callers updating one Character Card field no longer clobber unrelated fields (greetings, mes_example, creator_notes, system_prompt, post_history_instructions, character versions, alternate_greetings) — safe to let Mari edit a single field on a finished card.

title: Sprite transparency pipeline reworked
reality: v2.3.0 reworked Character and Persona sprite transparency around a native-alpha-first pipeline: providers that cannot return transparent PNGs get a subject-aware saturated chroma matte, then border-connected soft matting and color despill; the optional neural background remover is now reserved for genuinely complex backgrounds; saved legacy white-background sprites remain cleanable with restore points.
fix: In the Sprite System section (~line 190), add a v2.3 paragraph describing the native-alpha-first transparency pipeline (chroma matte -> soft matting -> despill, neural remover only for complex backgrounds, restore points for cleaning legacy white-background sprites).

title: Avatar upload field added above Name in Character Metadata
reality: v2.3.3 added a clearly labeled avatar upload/replace field above Name in Character Metadata, reusing the editor-portrait upload and crop flow, so avatar replacement is discoverable on desktop and touch (2.3.3 Fixed).
fix: Update the metadata description at line 96 ('lead with a Title / comment field placed directly below Name'): note that as of v2.3.3 the primary identity block starts with an avatar upload/replace field above Name (same upload/crop flow as the editor portrait), followed by Name and the Title / comment field.

title: Personas gained Open Full Library
reality: v2.3.0 added 'Open Full Library' to Personas, with the same responsive card grid, search, sorting, preview pane, paging, scroll restoration, and editor return flow as the Character Library; v2.3.0 also restyled both full libraries with the Settings chroma text color.
fix: In the 'Character vs. Persona' section (or a nearby UI note), add that Personas now have an Open Full Library view mirroring the Character Library (card grid, search, sorting, preview pane, paging, scroll restoration, editor return flow) since v2.3.0.

title: <START> example-dialogue separator survives XML sanitization
reality: v2.3.0 (#3623) preserved the standard <START> example-dialogue separator through XML prompt sanitization, including cards whose importer had already encoded the marker, while still escaping other XML-looking card text.
fix: In the mes_example row of the prompt table or the Common Mistakes section, add a note that the standard <START> separator in mes_example is safe: since v2.3.0 (#3623) it survives XML prompt sanitization (including pre-encoded markers), while other XML-looking card text is still escaped.

title: Card macros now resolved at final provider boundary
reality: v2.3.2 (#3704) resolves {{user}}, {{char}}, and other prompt macros in opening greetings and /guided instructions at the final provider boundary, including lorebook routing and embedding scans, so late prompt injections can no longer send raw identity placeholders to models.
fix: In the Character vs. Persona section (~line 94) or the prompt table's first_mes row, note that since v2.3.2 (#3704) macros like {{user}}/{{char}} in first_mes, alternate_greetings, and /guided instructions are resolved at the final provider boundary (covering lorebook routing and embedding scans), so card authors can rely on them never reaching the model unresolved.

title: Character-panel filters now session-only
reality: v2.3.3 reset stale Character-panel search, tag, favorite, and scroll filters during the update and made them session-only, so reopening Marinara shows the complete Character collection; Full Library sorting and position preferences remain persisted (2.3.3 Fixed).
fix: Add a short note (Characters Panel / library UI context, e.g. near the intro at line 3 or the Persona library note) that as of v2.3.3 Character-panel search/tag/favorite/scroll filters are session-only and reset on app restart, while Full Library sorting and position preferences persist.

title: Persona-less Roleplay chats no longer inherit global Persona
reality: v2.3.2 kept new Roleplay chats Persona-less when the user selects no Persona — including the first optimistic message snapshot, provider prompt, scene generation, and combat context; only Conversation mode may fall back to the globally active Persona (2.3.2 Fixed).
fix: In the 'Character vs. Persona' section, after the {{user}} substitution sentence (~line 94), add: since v2.3.2, a Roleplay chat created with no Persona selected stays persona-less throughout (prompt, scene generation, combat context); only Conversation mode falls back to the globally active Persona.
